subject: Leadership digest — actionable highlights & QBR pre-reads
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, leadership@redwoodinference.com
Cc: product-eng@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership digest — actionable highlights & QBR pre-reads

Hi all,

Quick weekly leadership digest — focused items that need triage ahead of next week's QBR prep call. TL;DR at top, details + owners below.

TL;DR
- Wins: Hosted API 99.95% uptime for the week; new benchmarking shows 15% cost improvement on batching heuristics. (Owner: Marissa)
- Risks: One strategic customer (AcmeCorp) has a renewal hold due to a data-retention ask and a latency spike in EU region. (Owner: Vivek)
- Asks: 1) Confirm QBR slide deck by Thurs EOD, 2) Approve a one-time credit request for Acme (finance), 3) Ops to validate rollback playbook for the new batching change.

Details and context
1) Platform performance & cost
- Metric: median generation latency for hosted text endpoints is 210ms (up from 195ms when last sampled). Root cause: small fraction of requests encountering fallback routing (pb 1.2%). Marissa is running a correlational slice by model/seq_len.
- Action: Marissa to share short slide with 95th/median/requests-by-model by Wed. Impact to QBR: include slide showing cost/unit improvement + active mitigations.

2) AcmeCorp renewal (high priority)
- Customer note: Sara Whitman has elevated a data-retention and audit-log SLA question. Also reported a transient spike in latency from EU region last Thursday that they saw on 09/02.
- Proposed immediate steps: Ops to provide timelines for audit-log export; Sales+Legal to draft a one-page SOW amendment for retention; Finance to sign off on a potential one-time $20k credit to keep deal moving.
- Owner: Vivek to coordinate with Sara; Marissa & Legal to provide artifact by Fri.

3) QBR deck & OKRs
- I attached the current deck + OKR tracker. Please add any addenda to the shared drive link by Thu EOD. I'm consolidating into a two-slide exec summary.

4) Small wins (short bullets)
- New auto-batching heuristic released to canary on 9/1 — internal perf shows 15% lower token-cost on chat workloads.
- SOC2 documentation update: control maps updated, audit evidence bucket staged.

Immediate asks (please action before Thu EOD so I can fold into QBR):
- Marissa: slides with perf distribution + canary rollback checklist (one pager).
- Vivek: customer-facing SOW amendment draft and decision on credit.
- Laura: slice of executive asks you want surfaced in pack (max 2 items).
- Finance: note on one-time credit feasibility.

Attachments: 2026Q3-QBR-draft-v2.pptx; OKR-tracker-2026Q3.xlsx; customer-escalation-timelines.pdf

Thanks — short sync planned on Fri morning but please flag any blockers earlier.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, leadership@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership digest — actionable highlights & QBR pre-reads

Thanks Hannah — helpful summary. A couple quick asks:

1) On the perf slides, can you include 7d/30d comparison for fallback routing (helps tell if this is transient or trending)?
2) For the Acme credit: can you include expected impact to ACV and a short risk note for Finance to evaluate — i.e., is this a one-off to save renewal or does it set a precedent?

I'll surface two exec-level asks in the pack: (a) finalize SLA exception position for strategic customers; (b) a 90-day snapshot of cost/unit after the batching change.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Chief Product Officer, Redwood Inference

Quick notes from ops/renewals POV:

- Acme: I'm happy to lead the customer SOW and credit conversation. Preliminary ask to Finance: approve up to $20k one-time credit contingent on a signed SOW amendment committing to the retention SLA. We should request a written acknowledgement of the latency incident and a short joint remediation timeline.
- Canary/rollback: Marissa, important that we have a validated rollback playbook for the new batching heuristic. Request: Can we have a minimum 48-hour canary window in EU before any wider rollout? If not, we should produce a one-week rollback timeline and impact map.
- Escalation: copy of any customer logs or timeline would help; Ops needs the specific timestamps (UTC) for the spikes. Sara — if you can provide the log export stub, that speeds this up.

I'll add the finance ask to my renewals checklist and be ready to escalate to Sales leadership if we need a faster decision.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Customer Success & Revenue Operations

Folks — wrapping up the items for the QBR pack. Consolidated updates and assigned owners below (incorporating Laura + Vivek notes).

Consolidated wins/metrics (for the exec two-slide summary)
- Hosted API uptime: 99.95% (week ending 9/12)
- Median gen latency: 210ms; 95th percentile at 820ms (we'll include a 7d/30d comparison slide as requested)
- Cost/unit: preliminary -15% on chat workloads for bucketed requests (canary)

Open risks + mitigation steps
- AcmeCorp renewal: Vivek to own customer SOW + credit convo; Finance to confirm one-time credit feasibility by Thu EOD. Marissa to provide timeline for audit-log export and root-cause note by Wed.
- Batching rollout: Marissa to confirm canary window in EU. If canary <48h, Ops requires a documented 7-day rollback plan and impact map.

Final asks (actionable items before Thu EOD so I can close the deck):
- Marissa Cole: perf slides (7d/30d), canary compliance checklist, rollback one-pager, and the small slide with cost/unit delta.
- Vivek Kulkarni: draft SOW amendment and proposed credit language; log timestamps from Acme (if received).
- Laura Bennett: confirm the two executive asks to appear in the pack.
- Finance (cc'd via leadership distro): decision on up to $20k one-time credit; note on precedent and recommended approval guardrails.

Attachments included again: 2026Q3-QBR-draft-v2.pptx, OKR-tracker-2026Q3.xlsx, customer-escalation-timelines.pdf

I'll incorporate any final edits by Thu 6pm PT and circulate the final two-slide executive summary. If you need a quick sync, I'm available Thu 10:30–11:00 for a 15-min check.

Thanks — Hannah
— Hannah Schmitt
Head of Operations, Redwood Inference
